intent: Require confirmed native retirement before releasing a recognition model lease; preserve responsive cancellation and all mandatory qualification cases.
authorization: User requested completion, green checks, merge and verified publication.
observed_defect: The Java close boundary cleared its handle while registry deletion could leave a native cancellation shared owner alive. QNN free failures and partial initialization also needed explicit retained ownership.
changes: Serialize cancellation holders on a separate monitor. Close cancels first, then drains and excludes cancellation while holding the inference monitor and performing native deletion.
Register native sessions before initialization, explicitly retire dependent resources, and seal new admission after unconfirmed cleanup while retaining parents, libraries and model mappings.
Keep failed decoder ownership and model-use leases even when initialization failed before a Java handle was returned. Never retry an uncertain free.
Exercise production Java scheduling and patched QNN ownership through deterministic host fixtures in the existing required native gate.

validation.cancellation_scope: Actual production Java class with deterministic host-only JNI scheduling fixture; no model or hardware execution.
validation.negative_control: Unfenced production class failed because close entered nativeDelete while a cancellation JNI holder was active.

checked_qnn_retirement.scope: actual pinned and patched QNN classes with host C API fault fixture

decoder.scope: actual production decoder and actual Java API; injected native boundary, outer capture lease not executed

canonical_host_gate.scope: Repository host checks, generated bindings, resources, dependency provenance, regex and whitespace; no full Android or actual model execution claim

validation.independent_review: No actionable source blocker: Java lock ordering, cancellation drainage, native registry lifetime, partial initialization, uncertain cleanup and required driver coverage reviewed.
validation.scoped_ktlint: ktlint1.3.1 passed both changed Kotlin source/test files

preserved: All existing JNI/model cases, mandatory Nemotron CPU execution, bounded effective-memory admission, failure codes and final all-zero success condition.
Every existing workflow gate, release version, protected rule and physical qualification limitation.
Concurrent playback readiness, output restoration, timed input, translation, microphone behavior and device scrolling corrections.
limitations: Host scheduling and fake QNN C API fixtures do not qualify actual model inference, physical GPU/NPU placement, acoustics, battery or thermal behavior.
Exact final PR and merged-main hosted checks remain required before coordinated publication.
